name: River
long_description: River lets you work with AI across your apps, browser, files, and phone. Give it a project, like planning a team onsite, and it can research venues, build a budget, and put together the schedule using your tools and context. It runs on a separate desktop or cloud computer, so you can keep working and step in anytime.
one_liner: AI that works everywhere you do.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder & CEO @ River (YC F26). Previously enterprise SWE @ Roboflow (YC S20), Z Fellow, co-founder @ Outwork, CS @ UC Berkeley

launches.title: River - AI that works everywhere you do
launches.tagline: Work with AI across your apps, browser, files, and phone.
launches.body:
AI is like a new hire who hasn’t been onboarded. It can update a presentation, but first it needs access to the deck, the latest numbers, and the team discussion about what changed.

We built River to give AI that access and context. It can use your desktop apps, work in your browser, read local files, and operate apps on your phone.

**How it works**

Ask River to submit your expenses from a work trip. It can find the receipts in your email, fill out the expense form, and upload the attachments.

In the demo below, I plan a two-day team onsite with River.

<https://youtu.be/ok419UCSJBw?si=aixrGUAcO_wlxO5V>

River runs on a separate desktop on your computer or on its own cloud computer, so you can keep using your screen. You can watch its progress, step in, or check on it from your phone. It connects to hundreds of tools and lets you choose the best model.

**Try River**

100,000+ people have signed up for River and made over 1.25M requests. It’s available on desktop, web, and iOS.

Get started in two minutes at [meetriver.com](http://meetriver.com).

— Chandler
